title: Managed Backup: lifecycle and returned payment charges
content:
For Managed Backup, the lifecycle and returned payment charges basis governs charge posting.

## Policy clauses

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source business subtype.

Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, on-demand termination fee for on-demand exit, and returned payment fee per completed bank return.

An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining contractual liability in USD as its termination liability.

Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under tax rules.

The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing rules and its posted source meter evidence gate apply only to source business subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and bank-return fee source business subtype.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical completed restoration whose applicable resumption fee is zero, no financial fee event is created. Repeating the same already billed source occurrence and fee subtype is read-only even if presented under another handling attempt.
